initial_finding.title: Final remote verification template renders an unterminated Python string

evidence.cause: The outer f-string consumes the single-backslash newline escape in the manifest.write_text expression. The rendered remote program contains a real newline inside a single-quoted literal.

initial_finding.impact: The preparation template can create the archive and all196 SCP copies can complete, but the second remote Python program cannot parse. No remote manifest or final ACK is produced, and local retirement remains blocked by its ACK gate. The populated archive root also prevents replaying the unchanged copier.
initial_finding.minimal_correction: Escape the newline for the second Python parse (two literal backslashes before n in the outer source), refresh the source SHA, and rerun the fresh source review before any copy. No fallback or extra exception handling is needed.

resolved_findings.resolution: The extra backslash preserves the newline escape through the outer f-string. The actually rendered final verification program now parses successfully; both remote programs import json before use.
